01-email-phishing
Email Phishing Detection Flow

Upload EML
Read bounded bytes; calculate SHA-256

Parse MIME email
Extract headers, body, links and attachments

Inspect email indicators
Authentication headers, relay and URL signals
Enrich IP/domain data; check lookalikes

Classify subject + body, if model loaded
TextNormalizer → TF-IDF
→ Logistic Regression

ThreatScorerService.calculate_score
Combine available rule and model signals

Return risk score, severity and analysis
Preserve original evidence and results
ML classification is unavailable when the model cannot load.
02-url-analysis
Malicious URL Detection Flow

Submit URL
Strip input; preserve URL evidence

PassiveURLAnalyzer: urlsplit
Check userinfo, IP hosts, ports,
paths, subdomains and shorteners

DomainIntelligenceAnalyzer
DNS + RDAP + IDN/lookalike checks
Configured threat-intelligence lookup

SafeWebsiteAnalyzer, if enabled
SafeHttpClient: redirects and TLS
Inspect HTML forms and password inputs

_compute_overall_risk(findings)
Aggregate URL/domain/website signals

Persist findings and evidence
Return URL risk score and severity

03-identity-impersonation
Identity Impersonation Detection Flow

Submit sender / Reply-To / display name
Use validated impersonation request

normalize_email_claim: parseaddr
Derive domains from addresses
Reject contradictory domain fields

IdentityClaimExtractor
Select matching protected identity profile

IdentityComparisonService
Compare names, trusted addresses/domains
Check lookalikes and Reply-To mismatch

_synthesize_assessment
Sum supporting risk; discount counter-evidence
Cap score at 100

Return impersonation assessment
Findings, counter-evidence and limitations
No matched reference profile can produce insufficient evidence.

Adapter registry normalization
Account, timestamp, source IP and outcome

Enrich IP data; build account profiles

Run configured detection rules
